changelog.title: Resources, reserves and new infrastructure
added: New resources: Fuel, Raw Materials, Steel, and Luxury Goods.
Shortages now cause traffic, lower employment, and drops in approval and happiness.
Currency Reserves, tracked separately from your treasury based on net performance after loan payments.
Low reserves hurt national stability and trigger critical warnings.
4 new infrastructure projects: Oil Refineries, Mining Complexes, Steel Mills, and Luxury Districts. Each has upfront and maintenance costs.
changed: Nations can now hold a maximum of 3 active loans at a time.
Resources page redesigned with individual resource cards and a highlighted Currency Reserve panel.
Budget page redesigned with responsive tax and department cards, spending summaries, and visual surplus/deficit projections.
